name: All Wiring Needs
old_description: Network Wiring Contractor Solutions for Your Business & Home in Charleston, sc.
about:
All Wiring Needs operates from Charleston, South Carolina, providing network cabling and telecom brokerage services across the Lowcountry. The company is led by Ruslan, who appears in customer reviews as the primary point of contact for consultations and installations. No founding year or ownership structure is disclosed publicly.

The firm installs Cat5e, Cat6, and Cat6A copper cabling as well as fiber optic lines, deploys wireless access points, and configures routers, switches, and security appliances such as firewalls and VPNs. It also acts as an independent business internet broker, negotiating contracts with carriers including Verizon Business, AT&T Business, Xfinity/Comcast Business, T‑Mobile for Business, and Lumen. Additional services encompass office IT hardware relocation, Wi‑Fi signal assessments, and ongoing IT support.

Customers range from small businesses and managed service providers to residential clients in the Charleston area. Recent projects include a 7,000‑square‑foot office Wi‑Fi deployment, a corporate move requiring same‑day site assessment, home Ethernet wiring, and a security upgrade adding VPN and firewall for an office network.

All Wiring Needs positions itself as an unbiased telecom broker that works for the client rather than the carriers, advertising 15‑30 % savings through exclusive broker deals and full‑cycle support from quote through installation.
